mechanics.claim: Fiddlesticks can impersonate an Effigy by standing still and not acting nor being acted upon, hiding its health bar.
mechanics.quote: '''Fiddlesticks''' can pretend to be an ''Effigy'' by standing still and not acting nor being acted upon for 2 seconds, during which it hides its [[health bar]]

mechanics.claim: The impersonation is interrupted if Fiddlesticks moves, is affected by crowd control, is hit by an ability, takes damage, declares an attack, casts an ability or summoner spell, uses an item's active effect, potion, or consumable, or begins channeling.
mechanics.quote: Attempting to impersonate an ''Effigy'', or maintaining the impersonation, will be interrupted if '''Fiddlesticks''':

mechanics.claim: From level 6 onward, placing an Effigy also summons a Sweeper Drone at the location for 6 seconds.
mechanics.quote: From {{stil|experience|level}} 6 onward, placing an {{tip|Effigy}} also summons a {{tip|Sweeper Drone}} at the location for 6 seconds.
